FEAT-5-S163.title: Pydantic Validation Enforcement for Tool Inputs
FEAT-5-S163.description: Implement strict Pydantic-based validation for all allowlisted tool inputs, ensuring that incoming tool_use payloads are validated against their corresponding schemas and that validation errors are surfaced in a structured, non-executing response.

FEAT-5-S164.title: Anthropic Tool Use Block Parsing and Dispatch Loop
FEAT-5-S164.description: Implement parsing of Anthropic tool_use blocks and dispatch logic that routes each tool call through the allowlist, validates inputs, executes the handler, and returns structured tool परिणामs back into the agent loop.

FEAT-5-S165.title: Tool Router Unit and Edge Case Test Coverage
FEAT-5-S165.description: Develop comprehensive unit tests for the tool router covering allowlisted execution, rejection of unknown tools, schema validation failures, malformed tool_use payloads, and safe error handling paths.

FEAT-5-S166.title: Integration with Domain Facades for Tool Execution
FEAT-5-S166.description: Integrate the tool router with application facades (FindCare and EvaluateCare) to ensure validated tool calls correctly invoke domain services and return normalized responses compatible with the chat agent loop.
